paper: S.U.R.E. (Aquaculture Welfare Integration): Autonomous Sturgeon Welfare Monitoring in Recirculating Aquaculture Systems via Edge-AI and RAG-Enhanced Deterministic Fusion
one_sentence_claim: A deterministic safety backstop's soundness in a deployed LLM-plus-validator system never depended on the LLM reasoning correctly, only on one enumerable status field being extractable and the system defaulting safe when it isn't -- and this held even when the LLM component was demonstrably undertrained.
central_spine: narrow-enumerable-field validator interfaces make an unreliable LLM's failures harmless, measured across five architecturally distinct layers of one deployed system

primary_evidence.finding: 4-bucket behavioral classification (n=8): 50% unparseable-defaulted-to-ok, 38% parseable-and-agrees, 12% parseable-and-under-calls-and-escalated, 0% over-calls; 6/8 reasoning strings contain fabricated sensor values, including 2 of 3 in the agrees bucket

secondary_evidence_by_priority.finding: agentic tool-routing negative result, replicated and strengthened at n=9 (from n=5)
deployed operating point recall 0.782 vs. headline academic-argmax recall 0.719 -- both correct, distinct questions, 0.782 governs the safety discussion
INT8 quantization loses less accuracy (-0.0082) than fp32 ONNX/TorchScript export (-0.0104)
RAG threshold calibration favors precision (0.85) over the F1-optimum (0.84), an asymmetric-cost design choice
PSI binning sensitivity crossover: quantile more sensitive at delta<=0.06, equal-width overtakes from delta>=0.08
32 near-duplicate train/val frame pairs found; same-checkpoint re-evaluation gives a modest, quantified corrected vision-metric range

compressed_to_footnote_or_paragraph: G9/EXP09 twin_bridge -- unit-tested only, one auxiliary-evidence paragraph, never a named subsection
must_never_claim: that the paper invented deterministic override, interlocks, or runtime shielding (EQUIVALENT_KNOWN per novelty_flags.json; cite SIS/IEC 61508-61511 and RL shielding explicitly)
that the architecture 'solves LLM unreliability' in general -- the falsifiable claim is narrower: the validator's soundness is independent of the LLM's reasoning quality
that twin_bridge was field-validated -- unit-tested only, never exercised against a live Godot/CODESYS session
that the adapter-provenance caveat applies to G4/EXP04 -- it applies to G3/EXP03 and its derivatives only (G4 ran the base model, no adapter loaded)
that the G5 correction is a leakage-free retrain -- it is a same-checkpoint re-evaluation on a smaller held-out set
a confidence interval or generalization claim from n=8 (G3's entire fixed scenario population)

must_disclose_and_where.item: adapter provenance (8-example smoke-test dataset, not the 128-example v2)
must_disclose_and_where.first_in: System Architecture, at first mention of AQUA-1B/G3

must_disclose_and_where.item: live, unfixed 0.695 recall figure inside the production RAG knowledge base
zero k=1/k=2 sparse-frame coverage in the validation set
must_disclose_and_where.first_in: Results 5.3, beside the 0/98 full-frame-miss headline number
Results 5.1, every time the bucket percentages are quoted

surprise_markers: Results 5.1 opening beat: fail-safe defaulting dominance + fabrication-in-agreement, one combined beat
Results 5.1 adapter-provenance sentence is a confident disclosure immediately after, NOT a fourth surprise marker
Results 5.3: INT8 loses less accuracy than fp32 export
audience: applied-AI / ML-systems reviewers and practitioners building LLM-plus-validator pipelines in safety-critical or industrial settings; secondarily, precision-aquaculture / RAS engineering readers
success_condition: a reader who reads only the Abstract can state: 'the safety property here did not depend on the LLM reasoning correctly, it depended on a narrow enumerable interface and a safe default -- and the paper measured, rather than assumed, that this held even against an undertrained model, across five layers, with one full disclosed negative result.'
